sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    g.display_name AS genre_name,
    t.primary_title AS movie_title,
    t.average_rating AS rating,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tg.genre_id ORDER BY t.average_rating DESC) AS rn
  FROM titles t
  JOIN titles_genres tg ON tg.title_id = t.id
  JOIN genres g ON g.id = tg.genre_id
  WHERE t.title_type = 'movie'
    AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
    AND t.num_votes > 10000
)
SELECT genre_name, movie_title, rating
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY genre_name ASC

issues.message: 外层 SELECT 无 LIMIT 子句
issues.suggestion: 结果集按类型分组，每个类型仅返回1行（约28个类型），结果集天然有界。通过 run_sql 的 limit 参数控制即可，无需在 SQL 中添加 LIMIT。

issues.message: 使用 CTE (WITH ranked AS) 包含子查询
issues.suggestion: CTE 是处理窗口函数的标准写法，语义清晰且性能可接受。无需改写。

summary: 共发现 2 个低风险问题，无需修改 SQL。SQL 语义正确，性能可接受。
